title: Instant Transmission
blurb: The Instant Transmission sound from Dragon Ball Z — Goku's two-finger teleport, in audio form. The meme uses it for any sudden departure: leaving the party without saying goodbye, exiting a conversation that turned weird, vanishing when the check arrives. That zip means someone is simply no longer there, and no further explanation will be provided.
origin: Goku's teleportation technique sound from Dragon Ball Z.
